description: This is a shell script used for testing the diff-highlight tool, including setup for git repositories, custom test functions, and various test cases for diff-highlight features.

methods.name: dh_test
methods.description: A helper function that generates git diffs and commits, applies diff-highlight, and compares output to expected results.

methods.name: test_strip_patch_header
methods.description: Removes the patch header from diff output, starting from the first '@@' line.

methods.name: dh_test_setup_history
methods.description: Sets up a specific git history graph for testing diff visualization features.

methods.name: left_trim
methods.description: Trims leading whitespace from input using Perl.

methods.name: trim_graph
methods.description: Removes graph/hierarchy symbols from git log graph output for diff comparison.
